name: Alleluia Al Asr
description: Chanted during Vespers Praises at the conclusion of the Fourth Canticle in the month of Kiahk and Holy Lent. Alleluia "Al Asr" translates to Alleluia of the late afternoon, the time of the day during which the hymn is chanted.

name: Anok Pe Pi-Kouji
description: Psalm 151 chanted at the beginning of Bright Saturday.

name: Aretenthonti
description: The first verse of the 8th part of the Saturday Theotokia chanted in a melismatic tune in the month of Kiahk and Holy Lent.

name: Aretenthonti
description: The first verse of the 8th part of the Saturday Theotokia chanted in a melismatic tune in the month of Kiahk and Holy Lent.
Aspasmos Watos for Great Lent. Verses are also found in the doxology.
name: Aspasmos Watos

description: Mournful Psalm Chant in a melismatic tune, chanted in the 3rd hour of Thursday Eve and the 1st hour of Covenant Thursday of Holy Week. The tune is the same as Pek Ethronos.
name: Avechnon

description: Doxology for Lazarus Saturday.
name: Doxology
Entho Te Ti-Shouri
description: Hymn of the censer chanted in the weekdays of Holy Lent.
A hymn for the apostles of Jesus Christ. Chanted after the Synaxarium or during the distribution of the holy mysteries.
name: Enthoten Dhe

description: A hymn for the blessing of Saint John the Evangelist and Theologian, the author of the Book of Revelation. Chanted prior to reading the Book of Revelation on Bright Saturday.
name: Ere Pi-Esmou

description: Mournful tune of the Pauline Epistle in the General Funeral prayer of Holy Week.
name: Ethve Ti-Anastasis (General Funeral)

name: Genethlion
Gholghota
description: Hymn for the burial of the Lord, chanted in the 12th hour of Good Friday as the Conclusion Canon.

name: Great Hoos

name: Lenten Je Efesmaroout (Weekdays)
description: Lenten weekdays tune for Je Efesmaroout, chanted during the Distribution of the Holy Sacraments before Pi-Mairomi.

name: Kata Ni Khoros (Al Hegab)
description: Chanted prior to "Ya Kol Al Sofoof" for the Holy Resurrection. Known as "Kata Al Hegab", which translates to "Kata of the Veil" since it is chanted in front of the Altar Veil.

name: Kata Ni-Khoros (Distribution)
description: Chanted during the Distribution of the Holy Mysteries from the Feast of Resurrection until the 39th day of the Holy Fifty Days.

name: Ke Eperto
Khristos Anesti (Major)
description: The hymn of the resurrection, Khristos Anesti, in its major tune.
The hymn of the resurrection, Khristos Anesti, in its minor tune.
name: Khristos Anesti (Minor)

name: Lenten Kyrie Eleison

description: A hymn for Lazarus Saturday, chanted during the Distribution of the Holy Sacraments.
name: Lazaros Amou

description: Chanted in the weekends, first Monday and last Friday of Holy Lent after the Synaxarium.
name: Meghalo

description: Mournful tune of the hymn of the Trisagion.
name: Mournful Agios

name: Mournful Ti Shouri

name: Oukatee Shesees

description: The names of the 12 precious stones used for the foundation of the walls of the city, chanted in the 21st chapter of the Book of Revelation in Bright Saturday.
